About Me

Creativity with a story behind it.

I'm a beginner graphic designer who loves creativity, visual storytelling and learning new design techniques. Every poster, post or logo starts as a small idea — and I enjoy shaping it into something people notice and remember.

I'm currently exploring branding, poster design, social media graphics and digital content creation, and I'm growing with every project. I'm open to freelance work and internship opportunities.

My Creative Process

From a spark to a finished design.

01

Research

Understand the audience, the message and what similar designs do well.

02

Brainstorm

Sketch ideas, collect references and pick a color and type direction.

03

Design

Build the layout with strong hierarchy, balanced spacing and clear visuals.

04

Refine

Polish details, test readability and improve until it feels right.
